# Third-party art

These assets are included in the project and are released under CC0 / public domain on their OpenGameArt pages.

- Male player sprite: **Hero character sprite sheet** by Fry. [OpenGameArt page](https://opengameart.org/content/hero-character-sprite-sheet)
- Female player sprite: **Top down player sprite sheet (Julia)** by ArlanTR. [OpenGameArt page](https://opengameart.org/content/top-down-player-sprite-sheet-julia)
- Enemy sprites: **Stalagmite Monster** pack by Some Weirdo (Miteclops and Stalagmite variants). [OpenGameArt page](https://opengameart.org/content/stalagmite-monster)

The original third-party PNG files are kept in this folder for reference. The current game uses custom generated character and enemy art instead.

## Project character art

The player sprites in `assets/characters/` and enemy sprites in `assets/enemies/` were generated with Volcengine Seedream 5.0 Flash from reference images supplied by the project owner. Enemy backgrounds in `assets/backgrounds/`, the seamless battle ground textures in `assets/grounds/`, the spirit-fox idle/attack sprites in `assets/pets/`, and the attack effect sprites in `assets/effects/` were generated with the same model. The large preview drafts are kept out of the repository; the optimized game-ready PNGs are used by the game.
